metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2002 · Spider-Man
metas.description: A shy teenager is bitten by a genetically modified spider and uses his new spider-like abilities to fight injustice as a masked superhero.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2004 · Spider-Man 2
metas.description: Peter Parker is beset with troubles in his failing personal life as he battles a former brilliant scientist named Otto Octavius.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2000 · X-Men
metas.description: In a world where mutants (evolved super-powered humans) exist and are discriminated against, two groups form for an inevitable clash: the supremacist Brotherhood, and the pacifist X-Men.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2003 · The Matrix Reloaded
metas.description: Freedom fighters Neo, Trinity and Morpheus continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression and exploitation.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2004 · Troy
metas.description: An adaptation of Homer's great epic, the film follows the assault on Troy by the united Greek forces.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2004 · I, Robot
metas.description: In 2035, a technophobic cop investigates a crime that may have been perpetrated by a robot, which leads to a larger threat to humanity.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2003 · X2: X-Men United
metas.description: When anti-mutant Colonel William Stryker kidnaps Professor X and attacks his school, the X-Men must ally with their archenemy Magneto to stop him.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2004 · Collateral
metas.description: A cab driver finds himself the hostage of an engaging contract killer as he makes his rounds from hit to hit during one night in Los Angeles.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2003 · The Italian Job
metas.description: After being betrayed and left for dead in Italy, Charlie Croker and his team plan an elaborate gold heist against their former ally.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2002 · Equilibrium
metas.description: In an oppressive future where all forms of feeling are illegal, a man in charge of enforcing the law rises to overthrow the system and state.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2000 · The Patriot
metas.description: Peaceful farmer Benjamin Martin is driven to lead the Colonial Militia during the American Revolution when a sadistic British officer murders his son.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2003 · Underworld
metas.description: Selene, a vampire warrior, is entrenched in a conflict between vampires and werewolves, while falling in love with Michael, a human who is sought by werewolves for unknown reasons.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2001 · Enemy at the Gates
metas.description: A Russian and a German sniper play a game of cat-and-mouse during the Battle of Stalingrad.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2004 · Dawn of the Dead
metas.description: A nurse, a policeman, a young married couple and other survivors of a worldwide plague that is producing aggressive, flesh-eating zombies take refuge in a mega Midwestern shopping mall.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2003 · Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
metas.description: During the Napoleonic Wars, a brash British captain pushes his ship and crew to their limits in pursuit of a formidable French war vessel around South America.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2001 · A Knight's Tale
metas.description: After his master dies, a peasant squire, fueled by his desire for food and glory, creates a new identity for himself as a knight.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2004 · The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
metas.description: With a plan to exact revenge on a legendary shark that killed his partner, oceanographer Steve Zissou rallies a crew that includes his estranged wife, a journalist, and a man who may or may not be his son.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2000 · Battle Royale
metas.description: In a dystopian future, a group of students from a Japanese high school are forced by the government to compete in a battle, killing one another until only one is left standing.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2004 · Team America: World Police

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2001 · Spy Game

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2002 · We Were Soldiers
metas.description: The story of the first major battle of the American phase of the Vietnam War, and the soldiers on both sides that fought it, while their wives wait nervously and anxiously at home for the good news or the bad news.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2002 · Treasure Planet
metas.description: Jim Hawkins is a teenager who finds the map of a great treasure hidden by a space pirate. Together with some friends, he sets off in a large spaceship, shaped like a caravel, on his quest.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2004 · House of Flying Daggers
metas.description: A romantic police captain breaks a beautiful member of a rebel group out of prison to help her rejoin her fellows, but things are not what they seem.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2001 · Shaolin Soccer

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2001 · The Last Castle

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2003 · Open Range

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2003 · Ong-Bak: The Thai Warrior
metas.description: When the head of a statue sacred to a village is stolen, a young martial artist goes to the big city and finds himself taking on the underworld to retrieve it.

metas.description: An army major goes undercover as a college student. His mission is both professional and personal: to protect his general's daughter from a radical militant, and to find his estranged half-brother.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2003 · Koi... Mil Gaya
metas.description: A developmentally disabled young man tries to continue the work his father did in communicating with extra-terrestrials from outer space, which leads to something miraculous and wonderful.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2004 · Pusher II
metas.description: Tonny is released from prison - again. This time he has his mind set on changing his broken down life, but that is easier said than done.

metas.description: A gang of 4 Danish criminals are ordered by Færingen to steal a bag from a safe. When they see DKK4,000,000 in the bag, they keep it for themselves and head for Spain. They end up in a ruin of an old restaurant on Jutland and reno...
